title: rhododendron eritimum subsp. gymnogynum
intro: Rhododendron eritimum subsp. gymnogynum, commonly known as the Himalayan rhododendron, is a shrub or small tree species native to the Himalayan region. This plant is valued for its medicinal properties, which include providing health benefits such as anti-inflammatory, antioxidant, and antimicrobial effects. The therapeutic actions of Rhododendron eritimum subsp. gymnogynum include treating various health conditions, including fever, cough, and respiratory issues, due to its bioactive constituents, which include flavonoids, phenolic acids, and triterpenoids. Its bioactive constituents also contribute to its potential in inhibiting the growth of certain microorganisms and reducing oxidative stress.
